style_suggestion.reasoning: The rules tag Luxury from 'castle', and the site calls itself 'high class'. Gardens are a big part of how it shows itself (tours page: 'acres of beautiful gardens'; gallery full of garden, fountain, bridge and castle shots), so Outdoors fits. Note: prices start at $1,825 and the site stresses 'affordable', so a castle-themed reception center may not be 'super fancy'. The team could decide Classic fits better than Luxury; the castle → Luxury rule may need an exception for themed, budget venues.
